stem.text: In this question you should assume the vapour behaves as an ideal gas.
$0.175\,\text{g}$ of a volatile liquid produces a vapour of volume $4.50 \times 10^{-5}\,\text{m}^{3}$ at $100\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ and pressure of $1.013 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$.
What is the $M_\text{r}$ of the liquid?
